text: The project delivered national roadmaps, feasibility studies, and design guidelines. It strengthened the NFFC's capacity, agreed on a cross-border action plan with Viet Nam, rehabilitated the Damnak Chheukrom irrigation system benefiting ~8,000 households, improved flood management for at least 10,000 people, and trained ≥200 women with ≥30% female representation in CBDRM committees.
